english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a reflexive object or for emphasizing that she, rather than someone else, did or experienced something.
Use this when you need to state explicitly that it was him, or to emphasize the subject himself.
Use this when the singular they antecedent needs to be made explicit.
